decisions.why: the division's own 8 products (Dec Duodenoscopes, Eb J10, Eus J10, I10C, I20C, Magniview, Vivideo, Vnl J10) are named endoscope models on the manufacturer's own site filing -> core endoscopy equipment, endoscopy:endo.

the division's 5 products (Defina, Imagina, Inspira, I Scan, Optivista Plus) are Pentax's endoscopic video-imaging processor units, the companion capital kit to the Endoscopes division on the same site filing -> endoscopy:endo.

the division's product, Stella Line, is confirmed (pentaxmedical.com product literature, via web search 28/09/2026) as PENTAX Medical's single-use standard endoscopy accessories line for hemostasis, injection treatment and tissue sampling in the GI tract -> general endoscopy consumables, endoscopy:endo.
